item.text:
{
  "verdict": "changes_required",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "file": "packages/workflow-control/src/storage.ts",
      "line": null,
      "reason": "prepareTransition and commitTransition omit taskId when invoking the document guard. verifyBoundary consequently checks the publication directory instead of the accepted task worktree. If the task worktree's normative documents change while the publication copy remains unchanged, these transition boundaries still pass verification. This leaves the current-workspace repair incomplete.",
      "proposedFix": "Resolve the transition's authoritative task identity and pass it to verification. Define explicit verification of all relevant accepted workspaces for run-wide transitions. Add negative production-path tests with unchanged publication bytes and changed task-worktree bytes."
    },
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "file": "packages/workflow-control/src/documentApproval.ts",
      "line": null,
      "reason": "verifyBoundary resolves accepted refs from delivery_approved_heads and repair_approved_heads only. importWorkflowLineage writes its accepted ref to lineage_approved_heads, which this query ignores. Imported runs therefore fall back to the publication directory even when an authoritative imported task ref exists, allowing changes in that task worktree to escape document verification.",
      "proposedFix": "Include imported lineage in the trusted source-resolution policy, validate conflicting bindings, and test import followed by task-worktree mutation and restart."
    },
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "file": "packages/workflow-control/src/specialistLauncher.ts",
      "line": null,
      "reason": "RevocableSpecialistCredentialBroker.issue grants credentials without checking document authority. Its storage calls only validate scheduler/credential state. An active scheduler execution can receive credentials after its approval has been invalidated or quarantined by another verifier. The launcher's subsequent document check prevents container start, but occurs after the credential-granting effect.",
      "proposedFix": "Guard credential issuance using the persisted execution's run/task and current fences immediately before dispatch. Preserve unconditional revocation. Test invalidation and unresolved verification between snapshot staging and credential issuance, asserting zero issue calls."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "packages/workflow-control/src/documentApproval.ts",
      "line": null,
      "reason": "recordPlanningDocumentPublication calls establishDocumentSource outside its sanitized error handler. documentSources.git propagates execFileSync errors, whose messages can include the absolute repository path, command arguments and Git stderr. Invalid revisions or unavailable repositories can therefore expose sensitive host paths contrary to DB-8.",
      "proposedFix": "Translate provenance-resolution failures into bounded public reason codes at the publication boundary. Add tests for Git failures that assert no absolute paths, remote credentials or stderr markers escape."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "packages/workflow-control/test/activeSpecialistSettlement.integration.test.ts",
      "line": null,
      "reason": "The new launcher integration test constructs a typed TaskPacket whose retryBudget omits required waitDeadlineSeconds. This is a TypeScript error when the test is typechecked. The test also never parses this packet through taskPacketSchema, so transpile-only execution can conceal the malformed fixture.",
      "proposedFix": "Supply the complete approved retry budget and construct the packet through the public packet builder or schema. Retain evidence that the enabled real-Docker test and test typechecking pass."
    }
  ],
  "priorIssueAssessment": {
    "repositoryProvenanceAndWorkspaceResolution": "Partially resolved: repository identity checks are present, but taskless boundaries and imported lineage still select the wrong source.",
    "durableSnapshotValidation": "Snapshot-byte and binding checks now execute inside a durable attempt; failed settlement leaves pending evidence. Supplied tests cover tampering and settlement failure.",
    "workerPacketVersusPersistedInput": "The launcher now checks deep equality against persisted scheduler input before credentials or container dispatch. A substitution test is supplied.",
    "conflictingTerminalReplay": "Same-status terminal replay now rejects a different result using deep equality. Supplied tests exercise conflicting completed-result replay.",
    "bootstrapCleanupAfterLostApproval": "The cleanup-only route validates historical identity, disables execution adapters and permits cancellation after invalidation. Its supplied test covers an already-attested bootstrap.",
    "productionPathAndCrashCoverage": "Incomplete. Real launcher coverage is conditional, has a malformed packet fixture, and has no supplied execution results. The required combined crash scenario and comprehensive boundary matrix remain unproven."
  },
  "coverageLimitations": [
    "Static review of supplied evidence only; no commands executed or state changed. Line numbers are null because locations are identified by named functions rather than independently verified line offsets.",
    "No retained test outputs, tested revision, compiled artifact hashes, Docker image digest/mount report or hosted-check results were supplied.",
    "The mismatch/write-failure/restored-bytes test closes and reopens the store in one process. The separate SIGKILL test crashes before document reads. Neither demonstrates the required combined mismatch, failed invalidation, process termination, restoration and restart sequence.",
    "No comprehensive authority-consumer inventory or parameterized negative tests across all production boundaries were supplied.",
    "Referenced documentFixture, continuationFixture, schedulerDockerFixture and several external-effect compositions were not supplied, limiting independent validation of fixture authority and downstream enforcement.",
    "No supplied concurrent two-owner verification test demonstrates the complete race and settlement behavior.",
    "This review does not confer human approval or execution authority."
  ]
}
